method: Every route center supports a fully open 11x11 native grid-sample square (ten-cell span), subtracting actual physical objects, cliffs, map borders and all potential scripted gift foundations plus exits. Each distinct main/secondary route passes its corresponding authored midpoint (access within 32 cells) and both bases (access within 25 cells); widths are conservative square-clearance lower bounds. Global search avoids artificially constraining a wide alternative to an old one-cell centerline.
